summary: Frontend-only review of iteration_21 (mobile labels + review alert at bottom + settings email status after passcode sign-in). Tested at 390x844 (mobile) and 1920x800 (desktop) against public preview URL. PASS: (1) Mobile top bar fits on ONE row with all six items (logo + conn/GitHub, Search, Drafts, Changes, Review, Settings) at y=12-14 and max right-edge 376px <= 390px viewport; conn ::after shows 'GitHub' from data-short; drafts/prs/review/settings each have .mlbl children with text 'Drafts', 'Changes', 'Review', 'Settings'; d-count badges on drafts/prs are preserved. (2) All 7 tabs expose data-short and ::after content: Compose, Catalog, Artists, Projects, Models, Blog, Updates; switching to catalog moves the active class correctly. (3) Icon-only button scan across every mobile view found 0 unlabeled icon-only <button> elements: Catalog=230 labeled, Artists=29, Models=11, Blog=5, WhatsNew=12, Compose=16 (all 303 icon-only buttons have .mlbl). (4) Lyrics clear-time button [data-lact=clear] is correctly hidden on mobile. (5) Dock Review/Go live switch shows words 'Review' and 'Go live' in the bottom dock (verified visually in screenshots). (6) DESKTOP 1920x800: 267 .mlbl elements exist in DOM but ZERO are visible (display:none from base CSS). (7) Icon mode (mock-chelly) on mobile: #conn data-short='Icon', ::after content='Icon'; prs mlbl='Changes'; open-review button is correctly hidden (hidden attribute = true). (8) ITERATION_20 FIX VERIFIED: immediately after passcode sign-in with no reload, [data-testid=settings-email-status] reads 'Alerts go to s•••@proton.me when an Icon sends a change or asks for access.' and settings-email-alerts is visible — the one-render UX bug reported in iteration_20 is now fixed. FAIL — CRITICAL: Mobile review-alert at bottom spec. The alert container #rv-alert on mobile ends up with BOTH top:84px (from base rule) AND bottom:96px (from mobile media-query rule), so its bounding rect is {top:84, bottom:748, height:664} on a 390x844 viewport — covering the entire middle of the page. document.elementFromPoint at the center of tab-models returns the rv-alert div itself; Playwright click without force fails with '<div id="rv-alert" ...> intercepts pointer events'. The alert banner's VISIBLE pill is painted near the bottom (because flex-items default alignment inside the fixed box drops them in a corner), but the invisible flex container blankets the whole screen and swallows every tap on the tabs, Compose form, and everything in between.

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile, #rv-alert has computed style top:84px AND bottom:96px simultaneously, stretching the fixed container from y=84 to y=748 on a 844-tall viewport. The container has pointer-events:auto and z-index:58, so it intercepts every tap on the tab bar (Compose/Catalog/Artists/Projects/Models/Blog/Updates) and on the Compose form fields underneath. Repro: as admin, create any icon PR (e.g. POST /api/github/repo/pulls as mock-chelly), reload /songcoder.html at 390x844 → try to click [data-testid=tab-models] → fails with 'rv-alert intercepts pointer events'. Root cause: CSS source order. The base rule at line 996 `.rv-alert{position:fixed;top:84px;left:50%;...}` is defined AFTER the mobile override at line 986 `@media (max-width:760px){ .rv-alert{top:auto;bottom:calc(96px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));border-radius:20px} }`. Because the base rule is later in the stylesheet and has equal specificity, its `top:84px` wins the cascade for the `top` property on mobile, while the mobile rule still contributes `bottom:96px` (which the base rule does not declare). Net effect: both `top:84px` and `bottom:96px` are applied → container fills the viewport. Fix options (pick one): (a) move the entire mobile media-query block AFTER the base `.rv-alert` rule (line 996) so later-source wins; (b) add `top:auto !important` to the mobile override; (c) add `bottom:auto` to the base rule so it doesn't leave `bottom` undeclared (then let the mobile rule set both top:auto and bottom:96px cleanly); (d) in the mobile rule explicitly set `top:auto` with higher specificity like `#rv-alert`. Option (a) or (c) is cleanest. Note: the stated spec 'review alert moved to the bottom (above the dock) so it no longer covers the tabs' is actively broken on mobile.

rca of the issue: CSS source-order cascade bug for `.rv-alert`. The mobile override `@media (max-width:760px){ .rv-alert{top:auto;bottom:calc(96px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));border-radius:20px} }` is at songcoder.html:986 and the base rule `.rv-alert{position:fixed;top:84px;left:50%;z-index:58;...}` is at line 996 — i.e. the base rule comes AFTER the media query in source order. In CSS, when two rules of equal specificity match, the later rule wins for each declared property. The base rule declares `top:84px` but NOT `bottom`; the mobile rule declares both `top:auto` and `bottom:96px`. Result on mobile: `top` resolves to 84px (base wins), `bottom` resolves to 96px (only mobile declares it). The fixed container therefore spans from top:84 to bottom:96 (height ≈ 664px on a 844-tall viewport), covering the tabs, Compose, and most of the page. Although the visible pill content paints at the bottom (because of flex-item layout inside the oversized fixed box), the entire oversized box has pointer-events:auto, so taps on the tabs are intercepted (Playwright reports 'rv-alert intercepts pointer events'). Fix: either move the media-query AFTER line 996, or add `bottom:auto` to the base rule, or add `!important` to the mobile `top:auto`. Any of these restores the intended behavior (pill parked just above the dock, not intercepting the tabs).
